text:
anya: heads-up  perf regression in staging after autoscaler tweak. need a quick slice decision: reduce MVP scope or slide release 2 weeks.

sam: which items are candidates?

anya: shortlist: tenant SSO, telemetry export, admin analytics. embcache and core inference paths should stay.

maria: autoscaler fix + QA ~9 business days. short-term safe-config can stabilize p95 if we add runtime guards.

kevin: runtime guards proposal:
- canary ramp: 5% -> 20% over 2h if p95 < 850ms and errors < 0.25%
- emergency fallback: infra p95 > 1.2s for >5m AND errors +0.6% => route to stable pool
- if fallback doesn't cut tail by 30% in 3m => rollback
- per-tenant throttle: 200rps for first 48h

lina: sales: two pilots need SSO. offer a manual SSO pilot (SAML admin assist) if we trim it from MVP. call rollout a "controlled launch" in comms.

sam: engineering picks trimming SSO + pilot. less QA & keeps perf wins.

maria: agree, i'll own safe-config + rollback playbook. will include tracing hooks to identify offending routes.

kevin: i'll implement canary scripts + throttle flag. ops runbook will check gates every 5m.

lina: i'll prepare pilot sign-up email and FAQ.

release-bot: release window remains locked; canary schedule will be attached.

anya: decision: trim tenant SSO from MVP, keep embcache, keep telemetry for now, enforce canary + rollback guards, offer manual SSO pilot.

action items:
- maria: safe-config + rollback playbook  due Thu EOD
- kevin: canary scripts + throttle flag  due Tue noon
- lina: pilot comms + onboarding checklist  due Wed
- sam: update release checklist & feature flags  due Wed EOD

anya: reconvene Fri 10am for go/no-go unless blockers appear. :thumbsup:
